The Silver Arrows continue to lead both world championship races, and grew their leads in both standings across the Dutch Grand Prix Sprint weekend, but have seen their early-season dominance eroded in recent months. messages.text: England's Carse unavailable for Lord's Test after nightclub incident

metadata.summary: England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been withdrawn from the squad for the second Test against Pakistan at Lord's from Thursday following an incident outside a Derby nightclub that is being investigated by the Cricket Regulator.
metadata.content: Brydon Carse to miss England's second Test vs Pakistan as Cricket Regulator conducts investigation into nightclub incident | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content Brydon Carse to miss England's second Test vs Pakistan as Cricket Regulator conducts investigation into nightclub incident Video footage emerged of handcuffed Carse being led away by police on Saturday night; fast bowler had been out celebrating victory for Durham in County Championship after being released by England to play in game; Sonny Baker replaces Carse in squad for Lord’s Test from Thursday Monday 24 August 2026 16:57, UK Image: England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been withdrawn from the squad for the second Test against Pakistan at Lord's following an incident outside a Derby nightclub England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been withdrawn from the squad for the second Test against Pakistan at Lord's from Thursday following an incident outside a Derby nightclub that is being investigated by the Cricket Regulator. Video footage emerged of a handcuffed Carse being led away by police on Saturday night after Durham's players had gone out to celebrate their win at Derbyshire in the County Championship. Carse was seen talking to team-mate Matthew Potts with former England captain Ben Stokes also pictured in the background.
